commands: if (!(Test-Path node_modules)) { npm.cmd ci } else { Write-Host 'node_modules present' }
Write-Host '=== FRONTEND BUILD ==='; npm.cmd run build
Write-Host '=== CARGO CHECK ==='; cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml
Write-Host '=== ANDROID APK ==='; npm.cmd run tauri -- android build --apk -t aarch64 --ci

$apk='src-tauri\gen\android\app\build\outputs\apk\universal\release\app-universal-release.apk'; if (!(Test-Path $apk)) { throw "APK not found: $apk" }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .agent\out | Out-Null; Copy-Item $apk '.agent\out\NAI-V5-Studio-0.4.8-latest-translation-arm64.apk' -Force; Get-Item '.agent\out\NAI-V5-Studio-0.4.8-latest-translation-arm64.apk' | Format-List FullName,Length,LastWriteTime; Write-Host 'BUILD_COMPLETE'
